sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and app open ads.

Unlocks the Premium league settings that the server accepts. The server refuses custom scoring, release clauses, substitutes and player tracking. Actions that cost credits still charge you, with no confirmation.
